title: Pricing
subtitle: Five services, a published price for each. The only thing given free is the discovery call.
launchNote: −20% for the first three clients, in exchange for a testimonial.

discovery.name: Discovery call
discovery.description: Thirty minutes to understand your situation and tell you whether I can help.

diagnostic.name: O1 — AI Diagnostic
diagnostic.description: Two days to find where AI belongs in your business, and where it does not.
features: Two days inside your actual processes
A map of the tasks that can be automated
Three priority projects, sized in workload
Findings presented in person, document handed over
What should not be automated, and why

atelier.name: O2 — Workshop
atelier.description: Your teams, your cases, your tools — half a day or a full day.
atelier.priceNote: excl. VAT · half day / full day
features: On your own cases, not on examples
Hands-on with the models and the prompts
A prompt library that stays with you
Written material handed over at the end
Up to ten participants

sprint.name: O3 — Automation sprint
sprint.description: One workflow designed, built and put into production.
sprint.priceNote: excl. VAT · depending on the number of integrations
features: Scope fixed and written down before starting
One workflow delivered in production
Integrations with the tools you already use
Documentation and handover to your teams
The range depends on the systems to connect

pilote.name: O4 — AI Pilot
pilote.description: Ongoing support, so that what runs keeps running.
features: A monthly review, decisions included
Changes and fixes to the workflows in place
Watch on what changes and concerns you
Direct access, no ticket, no intermediary
Six-month commitment

aiact.name: O5 — AI Act check
aiact.description: Where you stand against the European AI regulation.
features: An inventory of your AI uses, declared and informal
Classification under the European regulation
The obligations that apply, use by use
A basis for your register and documentation
What to do first, and what can wait
